import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p = params
    return (p[0]*np.exp(-p[1]*x**2) + p[2]/(v*(1 + p[3]*x)) + p[4]*t
            + p[5]*v**3*t**2/(1 + p[6]*t**2))
